proposals.evidence: DEDR 1834 attests Tamil kuḷir/kuḷircci and Malayalam kuḷir/kuḷur coldness, and Kannada kuḷir cold. The selected simple survey cold forms continue that family; combined cold-water responses are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
